_comment: Talents (v0.58.0; design-progression.md stage 4, the user's direction: a big pool, three offered at random at each talent level, like a run upgrade). Hunter's own (lost on death). every: a talent every N levels (3, 6, 9...). effects: numbers summed across the talents a Hunter has, read by the game where each applies (game/talents.py lists the keys). requires: another talent, or an attribute at least so high. ALL names, numbers and the pool are placeholders.

keen_edge.name: Keen Edge
keen_edge.description: Blows that land have a 5% chance to do double damage.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: Another 8% chance for a landed blow to do double damage.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Once a hunt, falling below a quarter of your HP mends a third of it.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.description: +3 damage while below a third of your HP.

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.description: After a creature hits you, your next blow gets +3 accuracy.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.description: +2 accuracy when only one creature is in view.

hard_to_kill.name: Hard to Kill
hard_to_kill.description: One more faint each hunt before a fall is your last.

iron_will.name: Iron Will
iron_will.description: Hard blows are 30% less likely to leave a lasting injury.

clear_headed.name: Clear-Headed
clear_headed.description: Being dazed wears off 3 turns sooner.

burr_proof.name: Burr-Proof
burr_proof.description: Thorny creatures' burrs can't hurt you.

thick_blood.name: Thick Blood
thick_blood.description: Bleeding and poison last half as long.

quick_healer.name: Quick Healer
quick_healer.description: You heal on your own two turns sooner.

iron_gut.name: Iron Gut
iron_gut.description: Rations mend half again as much.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.description: Creatures that see you are 10% less likely to notice you.

unseen.name: Unseen
unseen.description: +2 damage against a creature that hasn't noticed you.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.description: One more of each material a creature leaves.

tireless.name: Tireless
tireless.description: Your rest after a hunt is 15% shorter.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.description: You walk a quarter again as far on the Brisering before a Pulse passes.

tinkerer.name: Tinkerer
tinkerer.description: Artifacts with limited uses get one more each hunt.

good_eye.name: Good Eye
good_eye.description: You can identify artifacts one rarity beyond your Identification.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.description: Shards you find lying about are worth half again as much.

well_liked.name: Well Liked
well_liked.description: Townsfolk pay 20% more for their requests.

guild_darling.name: Guild Darling
guild_darling.description: The Guild takes 5 points less of your earnings as dues.

quick_study.name: Quick Study
quick_study.description: All practice counts a fifth again.

born_fighter.name: Born Fighter
born_fighter.description: Practice with weapons counts half again.

woodwise.name: Woodwise
woodwise.description: Practice in Tracking, Stealth, Harvesting and Survival counts half again.

quick_recovery.name: Quick Recovery
quick_recovery.description: Your techniques rest 10 turns less after use.

patient_angler.name: Patient Angler
patient_angler.description: Fish bite 15% more often for you.

quick_strike.name: Quick Strike
quick_strike.description: Fishing: one more turn to strike when a fish bites.

fishwise.name: Fishwise
fishwise.description: Gutting a fish gives a fillet and a handful of scales more.
